paite: Migiloute siatna ding in enlah ke'n, akiang ua om ut sam ke'n.
heading: Thugen Sawm-le-kuana

paite: Alungtang un nuaisiahna asin ua, amukte un siatna thu agen uhi.
Pilna ziak in inn lam in a-om a; theihsiamna in hihkip in a-om.
heading: Thugen Sawmnihna

paite: Huan theihna in dantante hihdim in a-om, hauhna manpha leh nuamte tengteng in.
Mipil ahat; ahi, theihna nei mi'n hatna apungsak.
heading: Thugen Sawmnih-le-khatna

paite: Pina pil in na galdouna bawl ding na hi ngal a; huan thuhilhmi tampite ah bitna a-om hi.
Mihai a ding in pilna asang lua; kongpi ah akam aka kei hi.
heading: Thugen Sawmnih-le-nihna

paite: Kuapeuh hoih lou hih ngaihtuah, mite'n siatna deihmi achi ding uh.
heading: Thugen Sawmnih-le-thumna

paite: Mihai ngaihtuahna khelhna ahi; huan mite a ding in musitmi kihhuai ahi.
Vangsiat ni a na bahleh, na hatna aneu hi.
heading: Thugen Sawmnih-le-lina

paite: Sihna lam a puakmang a omte suaktasak in, huan thah a om dia mansate nangma'n suaktasak in.
heading: Thugen Sawmnih-le-ngana

paite: Ngai in, hiai ka thei kei uh na chihleh; lungtangte bukpa'n huai angaihtuah kei maw? Na kha kempa'n, huai athei kei maw? Huan michih kiang ah athilhih bang in ape kei ding maw?
Ka tapa, khuaizu ne in, ahoih ngal a; huan chep a khum khuaikhak.
heading: Thugen Sawmnih-le-gukna

paite: Huchi in pilna na khalam a ding ahi chih na thei ding; na muhleh, huchi in kipahman a-om ding, huan na lametna satkhiak ahi kei ding hi.
Aw giloupa, midiktat omna dou ding in tang ke'n; akhawlna mun hihsiatsak ke'n.
heading: Thugen Sawmnih-le-sagihna

paite: Midiktat lah sagihvei apuk a, huan athounawn ngal a; himahleh migilou tuahsia zoh in a-om ding hi.
Na melma apuk lai in nuamsa ke'n, zoh a a-om lai in na lungtang kipak kei hen.
heading: Thugen Sawmnih-le-giatna

paite: TOUPA'N huai amu kha in, amah akipahpih kei in, huan amah a kipan athangpaihna aheimang kha ding hi.
Gilou hihte ziak in kilungkhamsak dah in; giloute leng eng sam ke'n.
heading: Thugen Sawmnih-le-kuana

paite: Migilou a ding a kipahman om lou ding ahi ngal a; migilou khawnvak heklup in a-om ding hi.
Ka tapa, TOUPA leh kumpipa kihta in; huan akoi mahmah leng thuman lou ke'n.
heading: Thugen Sawmthumna

paite: Amau a pan a siatna lah thakhat a om guih ding ahi ngal a; huan amaute a pan tuahsiatna kua ahia thei?
Hiaite leng mipil thugente ahi. Vaihawmna a mite deihsak tuam neih ahoih kei.
heading: Thugen Pilhuai Dangte

paite: Kuapeuh migilou kiang a, na diktat hi, chi peuhmah; mite'n amah ahamsiat ding ua, namte'n amah akih ding.
Himahleh amah salte a ding in kipahna ahi ding, huan atung uah vualzawlna hoih ahong tung ding hi.
Dawnna dik pia mukte mite'n atawp ding uhi.
Polam ah na thilhih bawlkhol inla, lou sung ah nang a ding in huai tuh mansa in bawl in; huan huai nung in na inn lam in.
Abul bei in na inveng siatna ding in theihpihmi hi ke'n; huan na mukte in khem ke'n.
Ka tung a ahih bang in amah tung ah leng ka hih ding, chi ke'n; mi anasep bang in ka thuk ding.
Thadahmi lou kiang ah ka pai a, huan theihsiamna bei mi grephuan kiang ah;
ngai in, ling in akhannelh khin vek a, huai a alouma loulingnei in akhuhta; huan huai a asuang bangte achim khinta hi.
Huchih lai in ka en a, hoihtak in ka ngaihtuah a; ka mu a, hilhna ka sangta hi.
Tomkha ihmut zek lai, tomchik lusuk zek, khut khep a tomchik ihmut zek,
huchibang in suamhatmi bang in na gentheihna ahong pai ding a; huan mi kigalthuam bang in na taksapna hong tung ding hi.
